digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center reconciler live integration
propositions: A live reconciliation pass over a real store copy (not an empty repo) must prove data moves bidirectionally: DC-created issues appear locally AND local edits appear on DC issues, with zero unhandled exceptions.

The test store must be isolated by design: a separate git repo with no remotes, REBAR_SYNC_PUSH=off, and no Cloud credentials in the job environment, so ticket events cannot escape to production even if reconciler state is corrupted.

The store copy must be scrubbed of all Jira ID bindings and reconciler artifacts matching .bridge_state*, asserted by filesystem enumeration rather than by mutation counts, because a surviving binding can drive mass spurious deletions or outbound churn.

Every mutation in the comprehensive suite (14 inbound × 14 outbound) must round-trip and be asserted individually against named oracles that observe the actual data on both sides, never against an aggregate 'converged' line which is indistinguishable from no-op on an empty store.

Pagination must be exercised live by observing the server's effective page size, seeding at least 2×observed+1 issues, and asserting that all seeded issues are recovered in the inbound plan—catching the truncation class that shipped silently in get_parent_map, get_issuelinks_map, and fetcher._iter_pages.

Inbound assignee mutations must positively assert that the pass minted an identity (by observing the identity registry before and after, not by calling ensure_identity_for and comparing to its own return) and that the provider family is jira (not jira-datacenter), catching silent swallow failures like bug 5f48.
